blocking_gaps: No general-purpose WSL distro is installed and validated for repo work.
Repo mount behavior and line-ending policy under WSL are not yet proven.
Python, Node, Git, Docker, and kubectl parity under a general-purpose Linux distro are not yet proven.
npx is not currently available from the live shell.

recommendation.reason: Windows PowerShell is the currently proven execution surface for this repo and v26 should treat Linux as readiness-only until a real WSL distro is installed and validated.

required_v26_checks: Install and register a general-purpose WSL distro such as Ubuntu.
Verify repo access and path behavior from inside that distro.
Verify Python, Git, Node, and Docker CLI parity from inside that distro.
Run bounded smoke checks before deciding on a shell migration.
